newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 14.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - FEB 14.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Farmers have set up roadblocks slowing traffic down in protest of too high social security and tax contributions.
- Talks on plans of a pension reform have not yet reached a consensus.
- Hungary's insurance sector posted a 10 billion forints profit last year.
- Socialist members of parliament have submitted their proposals for improving the Socialist faction's work in parliament.
- Inventor Erno Rubik, father of the inventor of the Rubik-cube died aged 86.
